bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to the Community Stabilization Project.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; COMMUNITY STABILIZATION PROJECT.

$100,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $100,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for a grant to the Community Stabilization Project in the city of St. Paul to provide assistance to tenants and landlords. The funding provided in this section must:

(1) provide landlords with access to the necessary guidance and tools to comply with rental housing regulations;

(2) promote sustainable and efficient property management practices;

(3) enhance landlord-tenant relationships to reduce disputes, reduce rental turnover, and encourage the use of mediation to resolve disputes; and

(4) help landlords obtain rental payments by providing budgeting for at-risk tenants to improve stability, assist tenants in accessing rental assistance programs, and help renters obtain payment plans for tenants who are behind on payment.
